items.title: Commanders let clock run out, tie Giants 27-27
items.text: The Commanders blew a chance to win the game after a late Cam Skattebo fumble.

items.title: Cardinals agree to trade Marvin Harrison Jr. to Texans
items.text: The Texans got a win on Sunday, and then they got a new receiver.

items.title: Dan Quinn committed a fireable offense, and ownership knows it
items.text: Quinn is ultimately responsible for one of the worst examples of clock management, ever.

items.title: Dan Quinn: End of game mistakes my responsibility, no one else
items.text: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn slammed his headset down on the sideline as the clock hit zero in overtime of Sunday's 27-27 tie with the Giants and he got a chance to share what he was thinking as the Commanders blew their chance at a game-winning field goal try by letting time run out with the ball on the New York 24-yard-line.

items.title: Sunday Night Football: Zay Flowers active for Ravens-Falcons
items.text: While the Ravens won't have their starting QB, they will have their top receiver for Week 5.

items.title: Broncos draw even with Chargers after fourth down stop
items.text: The Chargers had a choice between punting or trying to convert a fourth down in their own territory with just over 10 minutes to play in Sunday's game against the Broncos and head coach Jim Harbaugh opted to go for it.

items.title: Seahawks lead 23-21 after Jaxon Smith-Njigba's touchdown
items.text: The 49ers feasted on three Seahawks' turnovers in the first half, taking a 21-13 lead into the locker room at halftime.

items.title: C.J. Stroud on reuniting with Marvin Harrison Jr.: It's perfect for him

items.title: 49ers use Seattle's three turnovers to take 21-13 halftime lead

items.title: Lions lead Cardinals 24-7 at halftime
items.text: The Lions gave up a touchdown to start the game, but since then it’s been all Detroit in Sunday’s matchup against the Cardinals.

items.title: Dre Greenlaw ejected for headbutting helmetless Ernest Jones

items.title: Broncos lead Chargers 10-3 at halftime
items.text: Sean Payton's return to calling the offensive plays for the Broncos has not resulted in a major change in fortune for the unit, but they did enough to take a lead into halftime for the first time this season.

items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs ties Barry Sanders for most TDs by a player under 25
items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs has already done a lot of scoring in his career, and now he’s put his name beside one of the all-time greats.

items.title: Jets snap losing streak with 17-12 win over Browns
